[attribute-xmlns-tbx]
=== `@xmlns:tbx` TBX Namespace Declaration

This is not an attribute, but the namespace pseudo-attribute. The value provides a prefix and URI to use for the TBX elements. All namespace prefixes must be associated with a URL. This namespace is required on a top-level element if the TBX-namespaced elements are to be used.

#### FIXED (not settable) on many elements; click for list and usage

<<element-adoption,`<adoption>`>>, <<element-app,`<app>`>>, <<element-app-group,`<app-group>`>>, <<element-standard,`<standard>`>>, <<element-tbx-termEntry,`<tbx:termEntry>`>>
|===
| Value| Meaning

| urn:iso:std:iso:30042:ed-1| The URI that goes with the “`tbx`” prefix.
| Restriction| This attribute has a fixed value which may not be changed in the XML document.
|===
